title: Iced Tea / Lemonade Juice Drink, Light

content.title: About
content.content: Iced Tea / Lemonade Juice Drink, Light is a refreshing non‑alcoholic beverage that blends aromatic tea with a light lemonade note. The drink is low in sugar, low‑calorie, and suitable for those watching their diet while still enjoying flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The base is black or green tea, providing a mild astringency and antioxidants.
Lemon juice adds vitamin C and natural tartness without artificial flavorings.
The light version contains about 30 kcal per 100 ml, roughly half the calories of typical sugary sodas.
It is often served over ice with fresh mint to enhance the refreshing effect.
In some countries it is known as “tea‑lemonade” and is a staple of summer café menus.

items.title: Tea antioxidants
items.content: Tea is rich in polyphenols that help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Vitamin C from lemon
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids iron absorption.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: The light version fits well into calorie‑restricted diets, allowing enjoyment without excess energy.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: High water content helps maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: No artificial colors
items.content: The product typically contains no synthetic colorants, making it more natural.

items.title: Caffeine
items.content: Tea contains caffeine, which may cause insomnia or increased heart rate in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Lemon juice raises the drink’s acidity, which can irritate the stomach if consumed in large amounts.

items.title: Citrus allergy
items.content: People allergic to citrus may react to the lemon component.

items.title: Sugar content in some variants
items.content: Despite the “light” label, some brands add a small amount of sugar; always check the label.

content.title: How to Enjoy
content.content: Serve chilled over ice, garnish with a lemon slice or a sprig of mint. Add fresh berries for extra flavor if desired. The drink works as a standalone refresher or as a base for non‑alcoholic cocktails.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 2–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days. Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight to preserve flavor and color.
